rationale: The proposed sequence addresses documented evidence and operational gaps, follows the requested Version 1 then incident/rollback sequence, and permits bounded implementation slices after accepted design and planning. This establishes suitability only: winner not established. The manifest contains no COMPARATIVE evidence on the top priority, trustworthy_evidence, and does not establish superiority over features_first or platform_first. This judgment grants no implementation or invitation approval.
separating_test: Apply the same four context probes and a small blinded set of reviewer tasks, including irreversible rollback and stale graph evidence, to thin prototypes of the candidate paths. Compare critical misses, false blocks, supported findings and time-to-useful-review under identical access and cost boundaries. The platform-first path must also demonstrate an existing task that requires its proposed platform change.
